segments.text: a burning cloud rolls off the mountain and buries a whole city. One of the few who live is locked in a cell.
Locked in? He can't even run.
He was jailed for a fight, sneaked out to a party, and came back. So: solitary. Stone walls, half underground, one slit in the door.
Then, just before eight, the cloud hits. Hot air and ash blast through the slit.
His back, his arms, his legs burn. His clothes don't even catch fire. And outside, everything goes quiet.
Around {28,000|twenty-eight thousand} people died that morning.
He waits in the dark for days. Then he hears voices, and he shouts. They dig him out.
The cell meant to punish him had saved his life. He was pardoned, and toured with a circus as the man who lived through Doomsday.
